capabilities: Create Todoist tasks from Markdown tasks tagged #todoist
Sync completion, reopen, and rename changes between Obsidian and Todoist
Map task hashtags to Todoist labels and !!1-!!4 markers to Todoist priority
Detach tasks with audit markers instead of deleting or completing them
Run audits, repairs, cache rebuilds, and diagnostics from settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Due dates are not synchronized in either direction, setup must be repeated on every device because tokens live in device-local SecretStorage, and the README warns against downgrading from 3.0.0 to 2.0.2 without restoring a full backup.
problem: Obsidian tasks and Todoist are separate apps, so users must manually duplicate and update the same task in both places.

relations.evidence: Todoist Bridge connects selected Markdown tasks in Obsidian with Todoist.

summary: Two-way bridge that syncs Obsidian Markdown tasks tagged #todoist with Todoist, keeping completion state, renames, and hashtags in step.
